quote: Unlike traditional distillation techniques, the student model retains the overall architecture of the teacher model
interpretation: Staged mixer/block/output alignment preserves surrounding donor shapes; reported budgets 3B/5B tokens. No D2048→256 or ternary conversion proof.

quote: The total distillation process for each hybrid model
interpretation: Chat conversion evidence with attention projection reuse and FFN transfer. Training example <5 days on 8×80GB A100; no T4 cost estimate.
Copies whole pretrained FFNs and continues training; partitioning small shards has different preservation conditions.

quote: the router needs to select exactly one replica from each segment
interpretation: Virtual grouping and output scaling address missing shards and normalized mixture shrinkage. Scaling formula assumes squared ReLU; SwiGLU result empirical.

quote: it has only one hidden layer with a single neuron
interpretation: PEER product keys enable >million tiny experts. Exact Cartesian top-k belongs to constrained additive score family; pretraining isoFLOP comparison, no original CPU ternary conversion.

quote: This outgoing weight must also be divided by
interpretation: Neuron replication preserves function with corrected outgoing weights and same elementwise operator. Omitting originals or changing normalization/operator breaks theorem hypotheses.

quote: aiming at capturing common knowledge and mitigating redundancy in routed experts
interpretation: Fine-grained segmentation and always-active shared experts provide alternative common/residual decomposition. Trained model results do not prove pretrained conversion identity.

quote: the residual connection and the output of the block must have the same rotation
interpretation: Full orthogonal rotation plus coordinated weight/norm/residual/head transforms preserves function; slicing removes dimensions and is approximate.

quote: Softmax does not have the capacity to express the true data distribution
interpretation: Rank restriction holds for logits/log probabilities modulo contextwise constants. Softmax probabilities can have higher rank; paper does not measure our actual bottleneck.

quote: using only 10B tokens sampled from the FALCON corpus
interpretation: SubLN, continual pretraining and attention distillation support task-specific ternary adaptation. Does not preserve donor recurrent architecture or prove general chat quality.

quote: fast and exact nearest neighbor search
interpretation: Foundational product-key retrieval, large structured learned memory. Exact search applies to structured keys; different value operator from engine experts.

quote: memory layers with their sparse activation pattern are almost entirely memory bandwidth bound
interpretation: 128B memory parameters/1T-token training and stronger factual results support sparse capacity at scale; bandwidth, dense core and training remain costs.

quote: we observe a significant performance decline
interpretation: Decoder-only splitting with new routing initially loses quality; reported recovery uses 200B tokens. Relevant counterevidence against lossless arbitrary splitting.
